definition: A change to job classification, pay grade, range, or band.
analytical_unit: deduplicated municipality × compensation cycle × compensation mechanism × side implementation event
caption: This map shows 43 distinct documented classification band change implementation events across 40 municipalities in 13 states. A change to job classification, pay grade, range, or band. The geography matters because it locates the process in the retained evidence. Darker areas contain more events, not more workers or larger wage effects, and the map is not a national prevalence estimate.
